title: 第25章 烈火之毒第26章 孙恒
lines: 第25章烈火之毒
眼前应该是一座庄园！
占地面积巨大，林木葱郁，草繁盛，远处还有大大小小一片湖泊群，如同泽国一般。
充满灵气的空气清新到极致，给人一种特别舒服的感觉。
车子停在庄园门前，白牧野下车之后，有些好奇的打量着这里。
“这里是百城最顶级的住宅区，最小的一套别墅，价格都在三亿以上。”姚谦轻声说道：“这套更是超过了三十亿！”
白牧野有些咋舌，这种偏僻到爆炸的郊区，竟然这么贵？
而且，白牧野只看见这一座庄园，其他的房子在哪？他也没看见。
这时候，一辆车从庄园里缓缓开出，大门自动打开，车子开到两人面前。
从车上下来一个看上去五十多岁的老者，穿着一身正装，带着白色的手套。头发有些白，但身材保持的很好，龙行虎步，一双眼非常有神。
先是对姚谦淡淡点点头，随后目光落在白牧野身上，审视般打量几眼，微微皱了皱眉。
“是他么？”
姚谦露出谦逊的笑容：“是的，孙管事，就是他。”
“符医？有点年轻啊，能画符？”孙管事上下打量着白牧野，眼神中带着质疑。
如果不是姚谦这些年积累下来的名声和信誉，恐怕孙管事的质疑会更直接。
“有志不在年高嘛。”姚谦笑着说了一句，然后小声说道：“刚刚城里那场骚乱，帮助城卫军解决掉黑幽灵的人就是他。”
“哦？”孙管事有些意外，随即点点头，干脆利落的道：“跟我来吧。”
白牧野跟姚谦上了车，行驶了大约七八分钟，绕过巨大如同城堡的主体建筑，来到庄园深处湖畔的一栋小别墅前。
“到了。”孙管事说着便下了车，对着从里面走出来的一个年轻女子微微点头：“小姐，人带来了。”
刚下车的白牧野一抬头，顿时愣住，跟那年轻女子异口同声道：“是你？”
“你怎么来了？”孙岳琳眼中有些惊喜，声音瞬间变得柔和起来：“你是想通了吗？”
孙管事在一旁微微一怔，眼神狐疑的在两人身上瞟了一眼，心说想通什么？这孩子年龄有点小吧？难道小姐喜欢这种类型的？
白牧野摇摇头：“孙校长，我是来给人治病的。”
“治病？你么？”孙岳琳脸色很精彩，然后看着一旁的孙管事，笑道：“瑞叔，你从哪把他找出来的？他会治病？”
“小姐认识他？”孙管事问了一句。
“当然认识，一中的高一学生，符篆师班的。”孙岳琳看着白牧野说道：“我想让他来百艺校培养他做明星，被他给拒绝了。”
如果不是白牧野长得帅，孙岳琳肯定不会这么介绍，绝对会把白牧野精神力只有二十的事情给抖搂出来，然后把他当骗子给赶出去。
“孙校长您好，我是中介师姚谦，现在是白牧野的经纪人。”姚谦开口说道。
“姚谦？我听说过你，你说你是他的经纪人？”孙岳琳微微皱了皱眉，看着白牧野：“你不是说你不想当明星吗？怎么连经纪人都有了？”
“只有明星才能拥有经纪人么？”白牧野奇怪的看了孙岳琳一眼：“另外，他是我的合伙人。”
孙岳琳笑起来：“行，白同学，你长得好看，说什么都对。走吧，我倒要看看，你这个大符篆师是怎么给老头子治病的。”
白牧野之前也没问姚谦给他找的病人什么身份，没想到居然是孙校董和孙岳琳的父亲，还真是巧啊，有点小紧张了。
这栋别墅外面看着不大，但内部空间并不小。
一进门便是一个挑空的客厅，巨大的水晶灯高悬，古色古香的祖龙风格装修，奢华中带着一股厚重感。
沙发上坐着一个看上去也就三十多岁的青年，留着寸头，双眼特别有神，跟孙家姐弟长得很像。
“爸，人来了。”孙岳琳冲那青年一笑。
这么年轻？
白牧野愣了一下，再看看孙岳琳，觉得两人年龄好像差不太多。
完全不像是父女，倒更像是兄妹。
不过也没敢问。
女人好像对年龄这事很在意，他在大漂亮那吃过很多次这种亏，早就学乖了。

Chapter 25 Poison of Fire
There should be a manor in front of me!
It covers a huge area, with lush trees, prosperous grass, and a group of large and small lakes in the distance, just like a land of water.
The aura-filled air is extremely fresh, giving people a particularly comfortable feeling.
The car stopped in front of the manor. After Bai Muye got out of the car, he looked at the place curiously.
"This is the top residential area in Hundred Cities. The smallest villa is priced at more than 300 million." Yao Qian said softly: "This one is more than 3 billion!"
Bai Muye was a little stunned. How could such a remote and explosive suburb be so expensive?
Moreover, Bai Muye only saw this manor, where were the other houses? He didn't see it either.
At this time, a car slowly drove out of the manor, the door opened automatically, and the car drove in front of the two people.
An old man who looked to be in his fifties got out of the car, wearing a formal suit and white gloves. His hair is a little white, but his figure is well maintained. He walks like a dragon and has a very lively pair of eyes.
First he nodded lightly to Yao Qian, then his eyes fell on Bai Muye, he looked at him critically and frowned slightly.
"Is it him?"
Yao Qian showed a humble smile: "Yes, Manager Sun, that's him."
"Doctor Fu? You're a bit young. Can you draw talismans?" Manager Sun looked Bai Muye up and down with doubt in his eyes.
If it weren't for Yao Qian's reputation and credibility accumulated over the years, I'm afraid Manager Sun's doubts would be more direct.
"You have ambitions and you don't have to be young." Yao Qian said with a smile, and then whispered: "In the riot in the city just now, he was the one who helped the city guards deal with the black ghost."
"Oh?" Manager Sun was a little surprised, then nodded and said crisply: "Come with me."
Bai Muye and Yao Qian got into the car and drove for about seven or eight minutes, bypassing the huge castle-like main building and arriving at a small villa by the lake deep in the manor.
"We're here." Manager Sun got out of the car as he spoke, and nodded slightly to a young woman who came out of the car: "Miss, we've brought you here."
Bai Muye, who had just gotten out of the car, looked up and was stunned. He said in unison with the young woman, "Is it you?"
"Why are you here?" Sun Yuelin's eyes were a little surprised, and her voice suddenly became softer: "Have you figured it out?"
Manager Sun was slightly startled on the side, and glanced at the two of them suspiciously, wondering what he had figured out? Isn't this child a bit young? Does the lady like this kind of thing?
Bai Muye shook his head: "Principal Sun, I'm here to treat people."
"Cure disease? You?" Sun Yuelin's expression was very exciting, and then she looked at Manager Sun aside and said with a smile: "Uncle Rui, where did you find him? He can cure diseases?"
"Miss, do you know him?" Manager Sun asked.
"Of course I know him. I'm a freshman in No. 1 Middle School, in the Talisman and Seal Script Class." Sun Yuelin looked at Bai Muye and said, "I wanted him to come to Baiyi School to train him to be a star, but he refused."
If it weren't for Bai Muye's handsome appearance, Sun Yuelin would definitely not introduce him like this. She would definitely expose Bai Muye's mental strength of only 20 and kick him out as a liar.
"Hello, Principal Sun, I am Yao Qian, an agent. I am now Bai Muye's agent." Yao Qian said.
"Yao Qian? I've heard of you. You said you are his agent?" Sun Yuelin frowned slightly and looked at Bai Muye: "Didn't you say you don't want to be a star? Why do you even have an agent?"
"Can only celebrities have an agent?" Bai Muye glanced at Sun Yuelin strangely: "Besides, he is my partner."
Sun Yuelin laughed: "Okay, classmate Bai, you are good-looking and everything you say is right. Let's go, I want to see how you, a great talisman seal master, treat the old man's illness."
Bai Muye hadn't asked Yao Qian the identity of the patient he was looking for before, but he didn't expect that he turned out to be school director Sun and Sun Yuelin's father. What a coincidence. He was a little nervous.
This villa doesn't look big from the outside, but it's quite spacious inside.
As soon as you enter the door, you are greeted by a spacious living room with a huge crystal lamp hanging high and antique Zulong style decoration, giving it a sense of luxury and heaviness.
Sitting on the sofa was a young man who looked to be in his thirties. He had a short haircut and particularly bright eyes. He looked very similar to the Sun siblings.
"Dad, we're here." Sun Yuelin smiled at the young man.
So young?
Bai Muye was stunned for a moment, then looked at Sun Yuelin and felt that the two of them seemed to be about the same age.
They don't look like father and daughter at all, but more like brother and sister.
But I didn’t dare to ask.
Women seem to be very concerned about age. He has suffered this kind of disadvantage many times with Da Meili, and he has long learned to behave.
